parts.context: Part 4: You will hear a lecture about the history and impact of the printing press. Listen and answer Questions 31–40.

questionGroups.instructions: Complete the summary below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
questionGroups.summaryHeading: The Printing Press: A Revolution in Communication
questionGroups.summaryText: Johannes Gutenberg invented the movable-type printing press around ___31___ in the city of Mainz. Before this invention, books were copied by hand, making them extremely ___32___ and available only to the wealthy and the clergy. Gutenberg's press used a system of ___33___ letters that could be rearranged to produce different texts rapidly. The first major work printed was the Gutenberg ___34___, of which approximately 180 copies were produced. The invention spread rapidly through Europe and is considered a key driver of the ___35___, as it enabled the mass distribution of new ideas.
